components.name: Primary contact action
components.description: Local flat cyan CTA; visual-only sample, with no scheduling handler. Icon-free label specimen.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 14px; min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--accent, #09c8ed); color: #03141d; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s ease; } .ds-primary:hover { background: #7ae7fc; transform: none; box-shadow: none; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-primary:hover:active { transform: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

components.name: Underlined process link
components.description: New homepage secondary action; label-only specimen linking within the panel rather than opening external services.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: #e3f4fe; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 7px; text-decoration-color: #3e768c; } .ds-text-link:hover { color: var(--accent, #09c8ed); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.8); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 14px; }

components.name: Preserved plain ghost action
components.description: Existing lower-page/cookie secondary primitive; plain variant has no custom hover change. No cookie handler is attached.
components.css: .ds-ghost { border: 1px solid var(--border, #233c4b); padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--text, #f5f7fb); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); transition: transform .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, color .18s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ghost { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

components.name: Navigation link group
components.description: Static desktop link-group specimen inside the observed nav surface; not the complete navbar. Original planet icon and blue/orange wordmark must remain in the actual navbar; no substitute identity is introduced.
components.html: SolucionesCómo trabajamosEquipo
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 72px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #233c4b); border-radius: 12px; background: #081620f5; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px #0005; backdrop-filter: blur(16px); font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; transition: opacity .25s ease, background .25s ease, border-color .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, transform .25s ease; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 10px 9px; font-size: .88rem; color: var(--muted, #b4c8d7); text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--accent, #09c8ed); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.8); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

components.name: Preserved chat text field
components.description: Non-submitting chat field specimen with explicit visible keyboard focus; the live form is labelled.
components.css: .ds-field-group { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 8px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.24); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.035); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.02); } .ds-chat-input { min-width: 0; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 12px; color: var(--text, #f5f7fb); outline: none; caret-color: var(--accent, #09c8ed); } .ds-chat-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted, #b4c8d7); } .ds-chat-input:hover { background: transparent; } .ds-chat-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #09c8ed); outline-offset: -2px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-field-group { padding: 4px; border-radius: 16px; } .ds-chat-input { padding: 9px 10px; font-size: 16px; } }

components.name: Preserved chat quick reply
components.description: Existing chat chip appearance only; no sendQuick handler, data submission or external service. Browser-default button family is retained as in the source.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--text, #f5f7fb); padding: 8px 11px; cursor: pointer; text-align: left; flex: 0 0 auto; max-width: 245px; font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.25; white-space: normal; transition: border-color .2s ease, background .2s ease, color .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(0,195,255,0.6); color: var(--accent, #09c8ed); background: rgba(0,195,255,0.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-chip:disabled { opacity: .58; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-chip { max-width: 185px; min-height: 44px; padding: 7px 10px; font-size: .78rem; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chip { animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; } }

components.name: Preserved case surface
components.description: Existing lower-page case-card styling. Neutral specimen label intentionally avoids repeating unvalidated numerical claims; static, not clickable.
components.html:
Muestra de superficie

Contenido ilustrativo, no un resultado verificado.
components.css: .ds-case { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 18px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #233c4b); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--panel, #0c1a25); box-shadow: var(--glow, none); font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text, #f5f7fb); } .ds-case-title { color: var(--accent, #09c8ed); } .ds-case-copy { margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #b4c8d7); }

components.css: .ds-workbench { padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--border, #233c4b); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; background: #091923; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #f5f7fb); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-workbench-head { padding: 18px 24px; display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #233c4b); background: #0b1e2a; } .ds-workbench-title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #78e5fb; } .ds-workbench-disclosure { margin: 0; color: #b4c8d7; font-size: .81rem; } .ds-detail { padding: 24px 28px; } .ds-reference { margin: 0 0 10px; color: #9fb8c9; font-size: .76rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-detail-title { margin: 0 0 18px; font-size: 1.2rem; } .ds-detail-copy { margin: 0; color: #d5e7f1; font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.6; } @media (max-width: 600px) { .ds-workbench-head { display: block; padding: 18px; } .ds-workbench-disclosure { font-size: .75rem; margin-top: 5px; } .ds-detail { padding: 22px; } }

components.name: Example selection states
components.description: Selected and unselected example-tab visuals; labels copied from the homepage. No tab switching controller is included. The website retains click, Left/Right, Home/End and roving tabindex behavior.
components.css: .ds-tab-samples { display: grid; gap: 8px; } .ds-tab { width: 100%; min-height: 65px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: #c6dce9; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; text-align: left; padding: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-label { display: block; font-size: .92rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tab-subtitle { display: block; color: #a2c1d3; margin-top: 3px; font-size: .78rem; } .ds-tab-selected { background: #0b3b50; border-color: #23758b; color: #ebfaff; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #123343; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.8); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Preserved chat send control
components.description: Existing gradient send primitive, not the new flat contact CTA. Inert type=button specimen, never submits a message; no custom hover fill in source.
components.css: .ds-send { min-height: 44px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--accent, #09c8ed), var(--accent-2, #7af0ff)); color: #041320; font-weight: 800; border: none; border-radius: 14px; padding: 10px 15px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,195,255,0.32); } .ds-send:hover { background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--accent, #09c8ed), var(--accent-2, #7af0ff)); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(0,195,255,0.8); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-send:disabled { opacity: .58; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-send { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; } }

narrative.overview:
This records the approved, previously published homepage identity and the local audit corrections of 2026-09-29. Its sources are home-base.css, home-studio.css, ui-controls.css and the homepage controllers. The user approved committing and publishing this correction batch on 2026-09-29. Subsequent Shape proposals are separate planning artifacts, not part of this release. It is not a mandate to redesign sector landings.

Dark navy surfaces, cyan actions and the original planet with its blue/orange wordmark express NOVAIX as a software and integrations company. AI remains conditional on business value. This is documentation of existing code, not a redesign or new QA claim.
keyCharacteristics: Approved HD planet and blue/orange wordmark, prominent on mobile.
Dark tonal surfaces, Oxanium 800 hero H1, Space Grotesk body and flat primary actions.
Clearly illustrative example tabs coexist with retained lower-page functionality.

rules.name: The Original Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep the exact planet and blue/orange wordmark prominent; neither a generic text logo nor a cyan recoloring substitutes for them.

rules.name: The Scoped Depth Rule
rules.body: Flat new homepage actions and panels do not authorize stripping effects from retained lower modules or other landing pages.

dos: **Do** preserve the exact original planet and blue/orange wordmark, with the planet before the copy on small mobile screens.
**Do** use actual scoped dark tokens and final cascade values for this homepage.
**Do** keep software and integrations first, with AI conditional on business value.
**Do** preserve example disclosures, keyboard behavior and existing lower functionality.
donts: **Don't** interpret local selection or documentation as production approval or permission to publish.
**Don't** impose this homepage composition on sector landings or other pages.
**Don't** replace the dark identity with the rejected light concept or generic/generated identity assets.
**Don't** promote illustrative examples, tonal ramps or preserved numerical claims into verified production facts.
